generators.model: Blender (bpy Python module) — the PS-244 procedural scene rendered at a quarter size with no anti-aliasing
generators.version: bpy 5.2.2 LTS (PyPI wheel), Cycles CPU + OpenImageDenoise
generators.license: Project-original: every mesh, material, and light is generated by the committed scripts; Blender is GPL-licensed software and its output carries no license obligation
generators.commercialUse: Allowed; no third-party asset, reference pack, logo, trademark, or character is used
generators.hash: Per-file SHA-256 is recorded in art-pipeline/ps250-pixel/outputs.json
generators.notes: Room and props at 384 x 256 with a near-zero pixel filter and one-pixel Freestyle outlines. Characters are not rendered: they are reduced from the committed PS-250C sprites.

processors.purpose: Per-image median-cut palettes without dithering; prop crops to the Q-style trim boxes; character reduction to the room's pixel size with contrast, sharpening, hard alpha, a one-pixel outline and a pixel contact shadow; nearest-neighbour x4; PNG; outputs.json hashes and previews

camera.notes: The canonical PS-244 camera for the room and props; the PS-250C orthographic sprite cameras (through the committed sprites) for the characters.
